intro.text: One of the princedoms of Alethkar, the home of House Kholin's people.

description.text: A quarter of all the Shards in Alethkar are held by people from the Kholin princedom.

title.text: The war on the Shattered Plains

items.text: After losing a duel to Adolin, Resi plotted with a noblewoman named Ralanat, who led a Kholin caravan into a ravine just inside the Thanadal princedom. Resi's men ambushed it and killed most of its guards and merchants, though Ralanat herself was unharmed.
